lines.rom: jaise atala himalaya aura jaise adiga sumera aise hi svarga dvara pai avicala khare kubera
vighna harana mamgala karana suno saranagata ki tera bhakta hetu vitarana karo dhana maya ke dhera
jaya jaya jaya sri kubera bhandari dhana maya ke tuma adhikari
tapa teja pumja nirbhaya bhaya hari pavana vega sama sama tanu baladhari
svarga dvara ki karem pahare dari sevaka indra deva ke ajnakari
yaksa yaksani ki hai sena bhari senapati bane yuddha mem dhanudhari
maha yoddha bana sastra dharaim yuddha karaim satru ko maraim
sada vijayi kabhi na haraim bhagata janom ke samkata taraim
prapitamaha haim svayam vidhata pulista vamsa ke janma vikhyata
visrava pita idavida ji mata vibhisana bhagata apake bhrata
siva caranom mem jaba dhyana lagaya ghora tapasya kari tana ko sukhaya
siva varadana mile devatya paya amrta pana kari amara hui kaya
dharma dhvaja sada lie hatha mem devi devata saba phiraim satha mem
pitambara vastra pahane gata mem bala sakti puri yaksa jata mem
svarna simhasana apa virajaim trisula gada hatha mem sajaim
samkha mrdamga nagare bajaim gamdharva raga madhura svara gajaim
caumsatha yogani mamgala gavaim rddhi siddhi nita bhoga lagavaim
dasa dasani sira chatra phiravaim yaksa yaksani mila camvara dhulavaim
rsiyom mem jaise parasurama bali haim devanha mem jaise hanumana bali haim
purusom mem jaise bhima bali haim yaksom mem aise hi kubera bali haim
bhagatom mem jaise prahalada bare haim paksiyom mem jaise garura bare haim
nagom mem jaise sesa bare haim vaise hi bhagata kubera bare haim
kamdhe dhanusa hatha mem bhala gale phulom ki pahani mala
svarna mukuta aru deha visala dura dura taka hoe ujala
kubera deva ko jo mana mem dhare sada vijaya ho kabhi na hare
bigare kama bana jaem sare anna dhana ke rahem bhare bhandare
kubera gariba ko apa ubharaim kubera karja ko sighra utaraim
kubera bhagata ke samkata taraim kubera satru ko ksana mem maraim
sighra dhani jo hona cahe kyum nahim yaksa kubera manaem
yaha patha jo parhe parhaem dina dugana vyapara barhaem
bhuta preta ko kubera bhagavaim are kama ko kubera banavaim
roga soka ko kubera nasavaim kalamka korha ko kubera hatavaim
kubera carhe ko aura carha de kubera gire ko punah utha de
kubera bhagya ko turamta jaga de kubera bhule ko raha bata de
pyase ki pyasa kubera bujha de bhukhe ki bhukha kubera mita de
rogi ka roga kubera ghata de dukhiya ka dukha kubera chuta de
bamjha ki goda kubera bhara de karobara ko kubera barha de
karagara se kubera chura de cora thagom se kubera baca de
korta kesa mem kubera jitavai jo kubera ko mana mem dhyavai
cunava mem jita kubera karavaim mamtri pada para kubera bithavaim
patha kare jo nita mana lai usaki kala ho sada savai
jisape prasanna kubera ki mai usaka jivana cale sukhadai
jo kubera ka patha karavai usaka bera para lagavai
ujare ghara ko punah basavai satru ko bhi mitra banavai
sahasra pustaka jo dana karai saba sukha bhoga padartha pai
prana tyaga kara svarga mem jai manasa parivara kubera kirti gai
siva bhaktom mem agrani sri yaksaraja kubera hrdaya mem jnana prakasa bhara kara do dura amdhera
kara do dura amdhera aba jara karo na dera sarana para hum apaki daya ki drsti phera
